test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 16 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The marked price of a book is ₹767. A shopkeeper allows a discount of 20% and still earns a profit of 30%. Find the cost price of the book (in ₹).
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (MP) of a book = ₹767

Discount = 20%

Profit = 30%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 - Discount%)

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 + Profit%)

**Calculation:**

Discount = 20% of ₹767 = 0.20 × 767 = ₹153.40

SP = MP - Discount

SP = ₹767 - ₹153.40 = ₹613.60

Profit = 30%

CP = SP / (1 + Profit)

CP = ₹613.60 / 1.30

CP = ₹472

**The cost price of the book is ₹472.**
